drift.rule: the brief's stop rule, run 1's pick.drift unchanged, R pods only, at each GSM8K read (every 50 steps): (pass < W0's 0.7817 or fits < 0.9215) and kl > the previous GSM8K read's kl (0 before the first) -> R ends there ('drift': {step, last_good}); its last state is last_good, the GSM8K read before, which is a save step. A read with a missing pass, fits or kl is not a drift stop; output-change-only reads never stop

drift.at_W0: pass and fits equal W0's: no stop

match.saves: every 25 steps from 50 to 400 (15 states per pod)
match.rule: Per seed, from R's results file: the crossing of target k is R's first read (every 5 steps) at or before the horizon whose multiple >= k; the horizon is the drift stop's last_good when it fired (none if it fired on the first GSM8K read), else no limit. The step for k is the first save step at or after the crossing. It is 'confirmed' when R has a GSM8K read at or after that step and at or before the horizon (a later drift stop cannot void it); R, N and F of that seed are then kept and downloaded at that step. Not confirmed when R has ended (done, drift, or a stopped check): 'not reached', no state for k. While R runs: 'pending' (crossed) or 'open'. Several targets may share a step. N and F of a seed may stop once R has ended and they have saved R's largest confirmed step (last_needed; 0: stop now). Steps are never matched across seeds.
match.expected: at run 1's r3e-6 growth: 2x crossed near step 125 (seed 0), confirmed at the next save step by the GSM8K read at 150; 5x somewhere around 335-410 or not by 400; 10x not reached
match.at_W0: every multiple 0: every target 'open' while running, 'not reached' when done

worked.rule: From the cluster reads (one card type, L40) at each target size k read on both seeds: gap_s = pass(R_s) - pass(N_s), R and N of seed s at that seed's confirmed step; spread = max(|pass(R_0) - pass(R_70)|, |pass(N_0) - pass(N_70)|), how far one arm moves between seeds at that size; floor = 2 x the larger of the two seeds' paired standard errors of R against N (qwen_rl.gain, problems that fit at both); margin = max(spread, floor). 'apart' at k if gap > margin on both seeds; 'below' if gap < -margin on both (N above R); else 'together'. A size is 'unread' if either seed lacks a confirmed step there (not reached, drift, 10x not reached) or a pass rate or standard error is missing. Verdict: 'apart' (RL worked: apart from its null beyond seed spread at a saved size) if any size is apart; else 'together' if any size was read (R and N together at every read size: reported plainly as a result); else 'no call'. Strict inequalities: a tie is not apart.
worked.blind_to: pass counts only answers that fit the window (fits is read beside it, not in the rule); two seeds give a spread from one pair, so the floor of twice the paired se keeps a near-zero spread from passing a tiny gap
worked.at_W0: R = N = W0: gap 0, spread 0, se 0, margin 0: 0 > 0 is false, 'together'
worked.control: E69 at step 100 (1e-6w10) as a stand-in: R 0.881 and 0.877, N 0.870 and 0.794 (seeds 0 and 70; paired se 0.0099, 0.0108): gaps 0.011, 0.083; spread 0.076, floor 0.022, margin 0.076: 'together', since N's seed spread is wide
worked.expected: lean medium: 'apart' at 2x (run 1: R 3e-6 at 150 held 0.891 while N at 1e-6 fell to 0.778 by step 100; a null at 3x the rate is expected to fall further); 5x read on at most one seed is likely, so 5x and 10x are likely 'unread'
